what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Guinea in Canada: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 4777 Guinean asylum seekers in Canada, 8.4% of all asylum seekers from Guinea.
Refugees from Guinea, a separate group, live mostly in France, Germany, Belgium and the United States.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Guinea with the RFDG in 2000 and 2001.
The fact pack does not give other reasons why people left Guinea.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2000 at 186 asylum seekers.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2024 and 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Canada.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Canada only.
